items.title: Microsoft Desktop Window Manager 0-Day Vulnerability Exploited in the wild
items.description: Microsoft patched a critical zero-day information disclosure flaw in its Desktop Window Manager (DWM) on January 13, 2026, in the Patch Tuesday update after detecting active exploitation in the wild. Tracked as CVE-2026-20805, the vulnerability allows low-privilege local attackers to expose sensitive user-mode memory, specifically section addresses, via remote ALPC ports. This could aid further…

items.title: Taiwan Endures Greater Cyber Pressure From China
items.description: Chinese cyberattacks on Taiwan's critical infrastructure — including energy utilities and hospitals — rose 6% in 2025, averaging 2.63 million attacks a day.
